definitions.ask: When today's review flips from not yet to met live, should the check draw itself once?
definitions.why: Closing the review is the strip's daily win; a one-shot draw never fires on note open

choices.label: Seal pops in and the check strokes on once (~0.4 s); never on load or for missed
Marks always paint static; no per-host memo, keyframes, or arrive tests
